id.description: NNN in dependency order; rollup tasks from reef-review use R<NN> (never referenced by blocked-by)

effort.description: ladder BASE for reef-attempt; any recorded FAIL escalates to high

blocked-by.description: numeric task ids that must be done first — the graph's edges; scripts/reef-graph.py computes the ready set from them and the guard refuses a dispatch with an undone edge

resources.description: shared things held while in-progress (port:3000, db, browser, heavy); slots from .reef/config.json resources.<name>.slots, default 1; the guard refuses a dispatch when none is free

tier.description: effort matched to risk; mech <=> light; design = replaces a failed mechanism or touches privacy/money/a guard (adversarial pass twice)

worktree.description: the task's worktree, written by scripts/reef-graph.py worktree; execution state, ignored by the plan stamp

verify.description: design -> judge (adversarial subagent); mech -> gate-only (hooks + golden test)

attempts.description: recorded FAILs; written only by scripts/reef-attempt

dispatches.description: implementer-dispatch odometer; written only by the reef-guard PreToolUse hook

last_failure_sig.description: normalized sha1 of the last failure; same sig twice in one round = blocked
